modreloader.preflight.already_loaded: Already loaded; updating requires a restart
modreloader.preflight.suggestion.invalid: Make sure this is a complete NeoForge 1.21.1 mod.
modreloader.preflight.suggestion.restart: Restart before replacing the jar; unload/update is not supported.
modreloader.preflight.suggestion.t4: Registry content needs a T4 soft restart/restart; A1.2 only supports T2/T3.
modreloader.preflight.suggestion.missing: Install the missing dependency and retry, or restart.
modreloader.failure.title: Load failed: %s
modreloader.failure.not_a_mod.summary: This file is not a NeoForge mod (no mods.toml).
modreloader.failure.not_a_mod.suggestion: Make sure it is a NeoForge 1.21.1 mod, not Fabric/Forge or a broken file.
modreloader.failure.invalid_metadata.sug: Re-download the mod; verify mods.toml and the jar.
modreloader.failure.already_loaded.summa: This mod id is already in the running ModList.
modreloader.failure.already_loaded.sugge: A1.2 has no unload/update path yet; restart before replacing the jar.
modreloader.failure.missing_dependency.s: Add the dependency to mods and restart, or load it first.
modreloader.failure.jbr_required.summary: T3 layout changes require JBR enhanced redefinition.
modreloader.failure.jbr_required.suggest: Use JBR 21 with -XX:+AllowEnhancedClassRedefinition, or wait for sidecar.
modreloader.failure.mixin_runtime.summar: This mod declares mixins, which need MixinRuntime (modId: mr); it is not installed.
modreloader.failure.mixin_runtime.sugges: Install MixinRuntime (modId: mr, version >= 1.0.2) into mods/ and restart, then retry.
modreloader.failure.unsupported_tier.sum: This mod needs a restart/soft restart; A1.2 does not hot-add it.
modreloader.failure.unsupported_tier.sug: Put it in mods and restart; registry content needs a T4 soft restart.
modreloader.failure.mixin_config.suggest: Check the mixin config, target and mod version; restart and attach the log.
modreloader.failure.mixin_target.summary: Target class/layout could not be redefined by JBR.
modreloader.failure.mixin_target.suggest: Restart; if it still fails, the mod may be beyond current T3 support.
modreloader.failure.redefine.summary: Target class/layout could not be redefined by JBR.
modreloader.failure.redefine.suggestion: Restart; if it still fails, the mod may be beyond current T3 support.
modreloader.failure.module.summary: The mod module could not be injected into the game layer.
modreloader.failure.module.suggestion: Check for a duplicate module/jar; retry after a restart.
modreloader.failure.modlist.suggestion: Check dependencies and duplicate mods; retry after a restart.
modreloader.failure.construct.summary: The mod constructor or lifecycle event threw.
modreloader.failure.construct.suggestion: Check the stack trace; listeners may remain after construction, prefer restart.
modreloader.failure.event.suggestion: Check the stack trace; event listeners may remain, prefer restart.
modreloader.failure.resource_pack.sugges: The mod may be loaded without resources; restart to load the pack normally.
modreloader.failure.rollback_partial.sum: Load failed and rollback was not fully successful.
modreloader.failure.unknown.summary: Load failed; the cause could not be classified.
modreloader.failure.unknown.suggestion: Copy details and check latest.log; report it if needed.
modreloader.preflight.invalid_jar: Not a valid jar/zip (corrupt or incomplete)
modreloader.preflight.invalid_file: File does not exist or is unreadable
